certificate.title: Set Up the Invoice & Receipt Extraction Skill in Claude Cowork Completion

course.description: Build a reusable Cowork task that processes a folder of PDFs and images, extracts structured invoice and receipt data, and outputs it ready for entry or upload — no manual keying required.
learningOutcomes: Apply the methods taught in Set Up the Invoice & Receipt Extraction Skill in Claude Cowork.

lessons.content:
The **Invoice & Receipt Extraction** skill is a saved Cowork task that processes a folder of PDFs and images and pulls out structured data — no manual keying required.

**What it handles:**
- Reads invoices and receipts in PDF, JPG, or PNG format
- Extracts: vendor name, date, invoice/receipt number, line items, amounts, GST/tax, totals
- Flags documents that are unclear, incomplete, or missing required fields
- Outputs a structured table ready for your accounting system or spreadsheet

**Why build it as a skill:** Drop in a new batch of documents each period and run it — the extraction rules stay saved in the task.
lessons.title: What this skill does

lessons.content:
1. Open **Claude Cowork** on your desktop
2. Click **New Task**
3. Name it: **Invoice & Receipt Extraction**
4. Leave the task open — the next step is where you write the instructions that make this a real skill

> **Note:** In Cowork, a "skill" is simply a task with good instructions. The name you give it is what you'll see every time you open it. Keep it short and descriptive — "Invoice & Receipt Extraction" is perfect.
lessons.title: Create the task in Cowork

activities.title: Write the skill instructions (this is the skill)

lessons.content:
In the task instructions field, paste the prompt below. **Replace the example details with your actual process — the more specific you are, the better the output.**

---

*"You are my Invoice & Receipt Extraction assistant. Each time I run this task, I will upload a batch of documents — invoices and/or receipts in PDF, JPG, or PNG format.*

*For each document, extract the following fields:*
- *Vendor/supplier name → Replace with your preferred label (e.g. "Payee", "Supplier")*
- *Document date*
- *Invoice or receipt number*
- *Line items: description, quantity, unit price, amount → Replace if your firm captures fewer or more fields*
- *Subtotal, GST/tax amount, total amount*
- *Payment method (if shown)*
- *Currency*

*Apply these rules:*
- *If a field is missing or unclear, leave it blank and flag the row — do not guess*
- *Flag any document where the total does not equal subtotal + tax → Replace with your own validation rule if different*
- *Flag duplicate document numbers in the same batch*

*Output a single structured table with one row per document. At the end, list all flagged documents separately with the reason for each flag.*

*Do not summarise or rephrase line item descriptions — extract them exactly as written."*

---

> **Make it yours:** Add your firm's GL codes, cost centre fields, or required columns. If you use a specific chart of accounts, include it so Claude can suggest account mappings.
lessons.title: Write the skill instructions (this is the skill)

activities.title: Run it and save your skill

lessons.content:
Your skill is ready. Here's how to use it the first time and every time after.

**First run:**
1. Open the **Invoice & Receipt Extraction** task you just set up
2. Upload a small test batch — 3 to 5 documents of different types
3. Review the extracted table — check field accuracy and any flags
4. If fields are wrong or missing, update the instructions to be more specific and run again
5. Once accurate, you're ready to use it on real batches

**Every period after that:**
1. Open the **Invoice & Receipt Extraction** task
2. Upload the batch of documents for the period
3. Review the structured output and flagged items
4. Copy the table into your accounting system or spreadsheet

**Tips:**
- Better quality scans = better extraction. Blurry or skewed PDFs will get flagged — that's correct behaviour
- If you have a large batch, you can run it in chunks
- Add your GL account codes to the instructions so Claude can suggest mappings automatically

You now have a reusable Invoice & Receipt Extraction skill — no more manual keying.
